subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do workflow/security owners approve advancing these fourteen pinned third-party action revisions, including the GitHub App-token and Codex-agent execution paths, after a final-head trusted run?
rationale: The diff changes executable third-party code in credential-bearing automation; implementation correctness alone cannot decide the repository’s supply-chain acceptance boundary.

options.title: Approve after final-head validation
options.body: Rebase the PR, verify trusted workflow output for the new head, and approve the pinned revisions after reviewing the sensitive action changes.

options.title: Hold selected action upgrades
options.body: Keep the existing pin for any action whose upstream change needs separate security review, while allowing independently approved updates in a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Close and regenerate later
options.body: Close this grouped update if its breadth prevents a timely supply-chain review and let Dependabot recreate a current smaller batch.

recommendation.title: Approve after final-head validation
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, verify trusted workflow output for the new head, and approve the pinned revisions after reviewing the sensitive action changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Its security classification is the only concrete routing signal available in the supplied history; a human workflow/security owner should make the final decision.
